power.notes: 140 W RMS per speaker. Agreed by dolphinaccessories.com ('Nominal Power Output RMS - 140W RMS'), woofersetc.com ('Power Handling: 140Wrms') and amazon.com ('RMS: 140 watts each side'). The 300 W peak / max transient figures are not stored as RMS power.

notes: Third-party copies only (dolphinaccessories.com, woofersetc.com, amazon.com). Sensitivity is NOT stored: 88 dB (woofersetc, amazon) conflicts with 91 dB (dolphinaccessories). The frequency range (55 Hz-22 kHz) is a marketing range with no stated criterion and is not stored as a response. No manufacturer page was reached. frequencyResponse.notes: 53 Hz - 20 kHz (+/-3 dB), gear4music.com D5 product page ('Frequency Response: 53Hz - 20kHz (+ or - 3dB)'). Same range on the gear4music ex-demo listing. Retailer copy only; no Equator manufacturer page was reached.

power.notes: Integrated amplifier: 2 x 50 W RMS per gear4music.com D5 page ('100 Watts of Power (2 x 50w RMS)'). Stored as the per-amplifier RMS value; the 100 W combined figure is not stored as a single rating.

notes: Third-party copy only (gear4music.com). driverCount 2 and active true are taken from the same page: '5.25" woofer and a 1" silk tweeter' and 'Active Studio Monitors'. woofer.notes: Four 12 in Sheffield 1200 speakers per bluebookofguitarvalues.com ('300W, 4-12 in. Sheffield 1200 speakers'). The 12 in figure is per driver; driverCount 4 comes from the same text.

frequencyResponse.notes: 'Usable frequency response' 29 Hz - 20 kHz per canuckaudiomart.com. reverb.com lists 'RESPONSE: 29Hz-20kHz'. The criterion (+/-3 dB, -10 dB) is not stated, so the source's 'usable' meaning is kept.

notes: Third-party copies only (canuckaudiomart.com classified, reverb.com listings). Impedance is NOT stored: 8 ohm (reverb) conflicts with 4 ohm nominal (canuckaudiomart). notes: Single third-party source (vintagetechnologyarchive.com, RS-1B 1985). Its own description is internally inconsistent (a four-way active system with crossovers at 150/800 Hz and 3.5 kHz in the text, versus 150/700 Hz/3 kHz/8 kHz in the spec list), so driverCount, crossover and response fields are not stored. The 400 W power handling has no stated definition and is not stored. The RS 1 passive copy (hifi-guide.com, 8 ohm, 89 dB) and the RS 1.5 technical sheet are different models and are not used. Pass-140 (2026-10-10): third-party tier applied to the single-source RS-1B values.
